title: Causal Masking on Spatial Data: An Information-Theoretic Case for Learning Spatial Datasets with Unimodal Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (percentage of syntactically valid moves, legal moves, and best moves) under teacher-forced next-token generation (conditioning on ground-truth tokens) versus autoregressive generation (conditioning on the model's own predictions).

Observing performance asymmetry (win/loss rates) when a model plays as White versus Black in simulated games against Stockfish agents, revealing limitations caused by training data where the strong engine always played White.
